about:
L & B Electronics operates from Eldon, Missouri, where it provides two-way radio communications sales and service alongside storm warning siren solutions. The company serves customers across Missouri, Oklahoma, and Kansas for siren installations, while offering nationwide mail-in repair and sales for radio and siren controller equipment.

The business sells, installs, and services American Signal Corporation storm warning sirens and repairs siren controllers from ASC, CD&F, Whelen Engineering, and Federal Signal. It also supplies encoders for siren activation across all brands. For two-way communications, L & B stocks new ICOM mobile radios, portable radios, and repeaters, and maintains an in-house service department capable of repairing most radio makes and models. A used-equipment inventory supports departments and organizations with limited budgets.

Primary customers include public safety agencies, emergency management organizations, and municipal governments that rely on outdoor warning systems and land mobile radio networks. The company's regional service footprint covers three states for on-site siren work, while its mail-in repair program and product sales extend to clients throughout the United States.

L & B Electronics distinguishes itself through its combination of multi-brand repair capability, nationwide mail-in service for siren controllers, and a used-radio program that addresses budget constraints for public safety buyers.
